projectDescription: A local MCP server that connects AI agents to Poland's national e-invoicing system (KSeF), enabling incremental invoice synchronisation, metadata listing, CSV export, and new-invoice review — all without routing data through any third-party service.
keyFeatures: Local-only MCP server — invoice data never leaves the user's machine
Incremental synchronisation with KSeF export packages (AES-256-CBC decryption)
Deduplication index prevents re-downloading already-archived invoices
Immutable, append-only audit trail (JSONL) recording every data access
Rate-limit-aware budget counter respecting KSeF's 20-exports-per-hour ceiling
System keyring integration (macOS Keychain, GNOME Keyring, Windows Credential Store)
KSEF_TOKEN environment variable fallback for headless/WSL/container environments
Claude Code skill installer for agent-aware usage context
CSV period statement generation for accountant handover
New-invoice review ledger tracking what has already been shown to the operator
publicApiSurface: MCP tool: export_period_statement(period: str, working_directory: str | None)
CLI: ksef-mcp purge [--nip NIP] [--od DATE] [--do DATE]
Config: KSEF_TOKEN environment variable (fallback token source)
